clauses.quote: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For the last 3 Financial Years) 117 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder must have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs 117 lakh over the last three financial years.

clauses.quote: OEM Average Turnover (Last 3 Years) 920 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: The OEM of the offered product must have an average turnover of Rs 920 lakh over the last three years.

clauses.quote: Years of Past Experience Required for same/similar service 3 Year (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder must have three years of past experience in the same or similar supply.

clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete / Startup Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete
clauses.summary: MSEs and startups get complete relaxation from the experience and turnover criteria.

clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete / Startup Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete
clauses.summary: MSEs and startups get complete relaxation from the experience and turnover criteria.

clauses.quote: In case any bidder is seeking exemption from Experience / Turnover Criteria, the supporting documents to prove his eligibility for exemption must be uploaded for evaluation by the buyer
clauses.summary: Bidders seeking an experience or turnover exemption must upload supporting documents proving their eligibility.

clauses.quote: Document required from seller Experience Criteria,Past Performance,Bidder Turnover,Certificate (Requested in ATC),OEM Authorization Certificate,OEM Annual Turnover
clauses.summary: Sellers must submit documents for experience, past performance, turnover, an OEM authorisation certificate and OEM turnover.

clauses.heading: EMD Detail
clauses.quote: Mediation Clause No Bid Details /EMD Detail P /Required No
clauses.summary: No EMD is required for this bid.

clauses.quote: the bidder shall be relaxed from the eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: MSE bidders are relaxed from the experience criteria, provided they meet quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder itself is MSE OEM of the offered products, it would be relaxed from the "OEM Average Turnover" criteria also subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: MSE bidders are relaxed from bidder turnover, and from OEM turnover only if they are themselves the MSE OEM.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT-registered startups are relaxed from the experience criteria, provided they meet quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Bidder Turnover" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT-registered startups are relaxed from the bidder turnover criteria, provided they meet quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid.
clauses.summary: Turnover must be proven with audited balance sheets or a CA/cost accountant certificate.

clauses.quote: the Bidder or its OEM of the product offered in the bid {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU
clauses.summary: The bidder or its OEM must have regularly supplied similar products to government bodies or PSUs for the required number of years.

clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts and delivery acceptance certificates like CRAC to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contracts and delivery acceptance certificates must be submitted showing supply in each financial year.

clauses.quote: should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 50% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU.
clauses.summary: For past performance, the bidder or OEM must have supplied 50% of the bid quantity to government buyers in one of the last three financial years.

clauses.heading: 6 Generic
clauses.quote: should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date.
clauses.summary: Buyer ATC requires three years of regular supply of similar products to government bodies or PSUs.

clauses.heading: 10 Generic
clauses.quote: Manufacturer Authorization: Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid
clauses.summary: Distributors bidding must furnish an OEM authorisation certificate with the OEM's contact details.

clauses.heading: 15 Turnover
clauses.quote: In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion.
clauses.summary: In bunch bids, the OEM of the highest-value primary product must meet the OEM turnover criterion.

clauses.heading: 16 OEM
clauses.quote: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India.
clauses.summary: For imported products, the OEM or its authorised seller must have a registered office in India for after-sales support.
